title: Temporary wastewater service for new Waikapū school
summary: Bill 116, an agreement for temporary wastewater service to a new Central Maui school, passed 9-0 on November 25 after members voted 9-0 in October to recommend it. If the county's new wastewater plant is not running when the school opens, expected in 2031, the existing Wailuku-Kahului plant would take up to 14,500 gallons a day. The director called it a Plan B.
